content.title: Exclusive-‘It’s scary’ - crypto workers under siege from North Korean hackers
content.summary: DETROIT/WASHINGTON (Reuters) -North Korean hackers are saturating the cryptocurrency industry with credible-sounding job offers as part of their campaign to steal digital cash, according to new research, raw data, and interviews.  The problem is becoming so common that job applicants now regularly screen recruiters for signs they might be acting on Pyongyang's behalf.  “It happens to me all the time and I’m sure it happens to everybody in this space,” said Carlos Yanez, a business development executive at the Switzerland-based blockchain analytics firm Global Ledger, who was among those recently targeted by the thieves, according to data supplied by cybersecurity companies SentinelOne and Validin, who are publishing a report about the cyber campaign on Thursday.
